thesis: CRVL is an uptrend (close 83.16 above SMA20 82.11, SMA50 76.13, SMA200 62.85) pulling back to its SMA20 after an earnings week. The price response to the print was net positive (11-04 gapped up from 82.64 to open 85.41 and closed 87.38), which partly answers the bear's unknown-print concern, and fundamentals are high quality with accelerating growth. It is not a tech name in a tech-led risk-off tape, but the rich multiple, the failed push at 89.76, and the missing news feed cap conviction, so this is Overweight rather than Buy.

EXEL is in a clean uptrend (close 69.57 above SMA20 65.63, SMA50 60.92 and SMA200 51.57, rs_63 +0.40), with steady profitable growth (latest quarter revenue +10.2% YoY) and earnings already past on 2026-10-29. It is in Healthcare, a sector leading in the current risk-off regime (XLV 21-day +9.9%), so relative strength is backed by sector rotation. Reward/risk from the 68.3 mid-entry to the 77.1 target against the 64.1 stop is about 2.1, which clears the 1.5 bar, but the 11/05 reversal from 73.69 on 4.4M shares, nearby resistance and missing news hold the rating to Overweight rather than Buy.

AMPH is in a clean uptrend (close 28.49 above SMA20 26.55, SMA50 25.35, SMA200 22.29) with accelerating revenue growth (0.4% to 5.4% to 8.2% YoY) and a cheap forward P/E of 8.57, and it sits in Healthcare (XLV), one of the sectors leading this risk-off tape. The reward/risk from the 27.95 zone midpoint to the 31.0 high against a 26.6 stop is 2.26, but the 6 Nov post-earnings spike to 31.0 was rejected to a 28.49 close, the stock is up 40.28% in 63 days, and the news feed was blocked, so this is a moderate call that only applies if the pullback entry fills.

KDP is a trend-4 uptrend (close 36.63 above SMA20 34.93, SMA50 32.78 and SMA200 29.87) with strong relative strength (rs_63 0.35) in a leading defensive group (XLP) during a risk-off tape, and the 2026-11-03 earnings event has passed. The edge is modest: it needs a pullback entry and a breakout through the 37.89 52-week high to reach 39.49, so it rates Overweight on a conditional entry, not Buy. Stop 34.0 and target 39.49 are kept from the technical card; the entry is set at the zone midpoint 36.1 and the zone's upper bound is cut from 36.63 to 36.1, because at 36.63 reward/risk is only 1.09, while at 36.1 it is 1.61.
